rationale: C23 is the strongest plausible template because it uses the same material drafting machinery: an order transferring or restoring governmental jurisdiction over specifically identified land, followed by separately enumerated parcels and extensive legal boundary descriptions. The child adapts that structure to Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administration tracts and adds registry and acquisition details. C22 and C18 also combine restoration of governmental land jurisdiction with survey descriptions, but they concern only single Hawaiian parcels and provide a less substantial structural parallel. The shared material is more than a broad land-management topic, although there is little distinctive verbatim overlap.

shared_material.child_excerpt: 1. RURAL: Parcel of land located in Wards Sabana and Pitahaya of the Municipality of Luquillo, Puerto Rico... bounded on the North... on the South... on the East... and on the West...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following parcels of land comprising a part of the Schofield Barracks Military Reservation and the Wheeler Field Military Reservation... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii... I. Beginning at the northeast corner... thence running by azimuths...
shared_material.explanation: Both directives implement a governmental-jurisdiction land disposition through numbered parcels followed by detailed legal boundary descriptions.

shared_material.explanation: The child mirrors the parent’s parcel-by-parcel organization, adapting it from military-reservation road parcels to Reconstruction Administration tracts.
